purpose: The KYC Verification Service collects identity information and document images from customers, submits them to an external identity verification vendor, and stores the outcome of each verification case.

components.name: kyc-orchestrator
components.evidence: The Service is implemented by kyc-orchestrator, which exposes five operations to the customer application

components.name: kyc-documents
components.evidence: Document images are written to the kyc-documents bucket (S3)

components.name: kyc-db
components.evidence: Case records are written to kyc-db (PostgreSQL)

components.name: Identity verification vendor
components.evidence: Verification requests are sent to the Identity verification vendor, and the vendor reports its result through a signed callback

flows.evidence: Document images are written to the kyc-documents bucket (S3)
Case records are written to kyc-db (PostgreSQL)
Verification requests are sent to the Identity verification vendor, and the vendor reports its result through a signed callback
